statement: The Federal Reserve raises the federal funds target range at an FOMC meeting concluding between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DFEDTARU shows an upper bound on 2026-12-31 higher than its value on 2026-11-10; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The target range upper bound on 2026-12-31 is equal to or lower than its 2026-11-10 value.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield closes at or above 5.00 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-11. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 records any daily value of 5.00 or higher dated between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-11 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 daily value dated 2026-11-17 through 2026-12-11 is below 5.00.

statement: WTI crude spot closes below 80.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 85.63 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DCOILWTICO records any daily value below 80.00 dated between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO daily value dated 2026-11-17 through 2026-12-31 is 80.00 or higher.

statement: The BLS initial release of November 2026 CPI-U shows a seasonally adjusted all-items monthly increase of 0.3 percent or more, published between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the BLS CPI news release for November 2026, first published between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-31, reports seasonally adjusted all-items CPI-U change of 0.3 percent or higher.
failure_condition: The initial November 2026 seasonally adjusted all-items CPI-U monthly change is 0.2 percent or lower, or no release occurs in the window.

statement: CISA adds at least one Google Chromium or Chrome vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists any entry with vendor Google and product Chromium or Chrome whose dateAdded falls between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Google Chromium or Chrome entry in the KEV catalog carries a dateAdded between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The EU adopts restrictive measures naming the Iranian cyber unit Shahid Kaveh or persons tied to it over the French refrigeration-controller attacks, published between 2026-11-17 and 2027-02-28.
resolution: TRUE if the Official Journal of the EU (EUR-Lex) publishes a Council decision or implementing regulation between 2026-11-17 and 2027-02-28 listing Shahid Kaveh or a named member of it.
failure_condition: No Official Journal act published 2026-11-17 through 2027-02-28 lists Shahid Kaveh or a named member of it.

statement: The US House adopts at least one article of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on a roll-call vote held between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: TRUE if a Congress.gov or House Clerk roll call dated between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-18 records passage of an impeachment resolution or article against Hegseth.
failure_condition: No House roll call dated 2026-11-10 through 2026-12-18 records adoption of an impeachment article against Hegseth.

statement: Pete Hegseth leaves the office of Secretary of Defense through resignation, removal or conviction between 2026-11-17 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: TRUE if the defense.gov leadership listing, or a White House announcement reported by Reuters and AP, shows Hegseth no longer serving as Secretary of Defense on or before 2027-03-31.
failure_condition: Hegseth holds the office of Secretary of Defense on 2027-03-31.

statement: Russia and Ukraine sign a ceasefire or peace agreement between 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: TRUE if both the Russian and Ukrainian governments publicly confirm signing a ceasefire or peace agreement dated 2026-11-17 through 2027-01-31, reported by both Reuters and AP.
failure_condition: No agreement signed by both governments with a signing date between 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-31 exists.

statement: USGS records at least one earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater anywhere in the world between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS ComCat catalog lists any event with magnitude 7.0 or higher and origin time between 2026-11-17T00:00Z and 2026-12-15T23:59Z.
failure_condition: No USGS ComCat event of magnitude 7.0 or higher has an origin time between 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-15.
